product.title: Drape Skirt 15
product.description: The Drape Skirt 15 Chandelier consists of 15 individual pendants gathered into 5 groups of 3 and supported by a series of 5 brass “skirt” structures along the length of a brass bar. The “skirts” attach to the bar by a series of simple slotted connections, allowing the “skirts” to hold the bar with the slight friction of the cords passing through the smooth brass tubes of the “skirts”. Each pendant features a 4.5”/110mm diameter diffuser of handblown Czech glass suspended on a fabric-wrapped electrical cord. The cords pass through and are affixed to the bar, and are evenly spaced around its length. The glass diffusers are available in both "dipped" glass, featuring the SkLO double-dipped flame-polished mouth and "textured" glass, featuring a soft, frosted finish and subtle sculpted vertical ridges. Cord lengths are field adjustable.
